meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 运行 /update-skills 后，Claude 会检查已安装的频道和提供商技能，让你勾选要更新的，然后逐个重新运行每个技能自己的安装步骤，从上游拉取最新代码覆盖旧文件，最后运行构建和测试来验证。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中输入 /update-skills 命令时触发。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills，更新所有已安装的频道技能
say.note: 会列出可更新的技能供你选择。

say.text: 重新应用 Slack 技能（/add-slack）
say.note: Slack 的代码会从上游刷新。

howto.what_en: Running /update-skills makes Claude detect installed channel and provider skills, let you pick which to update, then re-run each skill's own apply step to fetch latest files from upstream, overwrite old copies, and validate with build and test.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /update-skills in Claude Code.

say_en.text: Run /update-skills to update all installed channel skills
say_en.note: Lists updatable skills for you to pick.
Slack's code gets refreshed from upstream.
